bug_semantics: Cachet 3.x incident templates (implemented in dependency cachethq/core) store a user-authored template body and compile it when an incident is created from that template. BladeRenderer::render() passes the stored string to Laravel Blade::render(), so @php / raw Blade executes as PHP. TwigRenderer::render() builds a non-sandboxed Twig\Environment and createTemplate()s the stored string, so callable filters (map/filter/reduce/sort) and source() can invoke PHP functions or read files. CreateIncident::parseTemplate() is the trigger. Any authenticated user who can create templates and incidents (Filament IncidentTemplate/Incident resources have no isAdmin canAccess; API tokens with incident-templates.manage / incidents.manage, defaulting to *) obtains RCE as the web server.
flaw_origin: cachethq/core's initial commit (8173b931, 2023-08-23) only stubbed empty renderWithBlade/renderWithTwig methods. The first executable SSTI mechanism was written by James Brooks on 2023-09-18 in reconstructable PR #36 member f94b6e75e36d13d1e22c932e367514d935a9d8c4, which added src/Renderers/BladeRenderer.php (Blade::render) and src/Renderers/TwigRenderer.php (unsandboxed Twig Environment) and wired CreateIncident to IncidentTemplate::render(). Cachet 2.4.1 already sandboxed Twig after CVE-2023-43661; the 3.x reimplementation omitted that sandbox. PR #36's description deferred 'adding sandbox mode to the Twig renderer.' The member was squash-merged to core main as e98851b3 on 2024-03-26.

Fix: cachethq/core#403 squash-merged as beea6f1d4afa4406fbee1ec06e8436d47d111099 'Sandbox incident template rendering (#403)' (2026-08-03). Adds Twig SandboxExtension+allowlisted tags/filters (callable filters omitted) and disables Blade unless cachet.renderers.blade / CACHET_BLADE_RENDERER=true. Parent a615653b still has the unsandboxed TwigRenderer. Issue #4621 closed by jbrooksuk: 'Twig incident templates run under an allowlisted sandbox, and Blade template rendering is disabled unless explicitly enabled by configuration.'

reasoning: CVE-2026-69118 is a published VulnCheck record whose GitHub issue and PoC describe unsandboxed Blade/Twig compilation of Cachet 3.x incident templates, not a withdrawn advisory. cachethq/cachet v2.4.1 is not this sink (it already sandboxes Twig after CVE-2023-43661); the live product path is cachethq/cachet 3.x depending on cachethq/core, where the named files live. git log -L on core main first shows squash e98851b3 adding BladeRenderer/TwigRenderer; that squash was decomposed via public PR #36 members. The smallest first-write of Blade::render and unsandboxed Twig createTemplate is f94b6e75; its immediate parent a411c9a was tree-checked and lacks those files and call sites, so it is the BIC rather than the later squash, the empty 8173b931 stubs, or the 0643e1c8 style commit. AI attribution is taken only from that BIC commit object: human author/committer James Brooks with no AI trailers or bot identity (the later GitHub squash committer on e98851b3 is web-flow, not an AI generator). The matching fix on core main is beea6f1d (#403), which is an ancestor of the cachethq/cachet lockfile pin. Therefore this is a real vulnerability with a proven human BIC and an upstream fix: NOT_AI.
